notes: Direct HTTP fetch for discovery (nav JSON in homepage, sitemap-categories-1/2.xml, llms.txt) + Playwright (tier 2) to read each candidate's rendered 'N items' count, since the PLP grid/count is client-rendered (no static count in raw HTML, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's finding for this exact commercetools/Frontastic storefront). Site's own taxonomy exposes clearance genuinely under a top-nav 'Sale' mega-menu with an overall parent 'All Clearance Sale' (/categories/clearance-all, 1334 items) plus real per-category-family children each titled 'Clearance Sale <Family>' or 'Sale <Family>' in the site's own nav labels (Hanging Lights, Wall Lighting, Ceiling Lights, Ceiling Fans, Outdoor Lights, Lamp Shades, Lamps, Home Decor, Rugs, Mirrors, and Furniture via the /categories/sale-furniture URL which the nav itself labels 'Clearance Sale Furniture' - kept as Furniture Clearance, not excluded as generic Sale, because the site's own label uses 'Clearance'). This matches the shared engine's genuine-sub-structure pattern (parent + leaves), same as the prior Lighting pass's 'All X' parent nodes for this site. EXCLUDED as non-PLP/non-clearance: /pages/clearance-sale (an editorial hub page - 'Clearance: Home Decor And Lighting Sale, Save up to 75% off' - with no product grid of its own, only nav-style links to the real category pages above); /pages/decorating-outlet (a physical retail store locator page - address/hours/phone for the Richmond, VA outlet store - not an online PLP at all); /categories/rug-sale (loads as the generic 'Rugs' main-nav hub page, titled 'Buy Affordable Rugs For All Your Rooms', with editorial tiles like 'Best Selling Styles'/'Outdoor Rugs'/'New Rugs' - no product grid or count of its own); /categories/sale-lamps-and-shades and /categories/cyber-sale (both load with 0 products - a completely empty grid, no items count text at all; cyber-sale's own <title> is '2025 Cyber Sale: Lighting Deals', confirming it is a stale prior-year temporary promotional campaign page now emptied out, which is also excluded on Clearance-vs-Sale grounds even if it had stock). FLAGGED AS AMBIGUOUS rather than silently included or excluded: three small (2-3 item) categories found only via the sitemap - NOT linked anywhere in the current homepage mega-nav (checked by string search for their slugs in the parsed nav JSON, zero hits) - /categories/sale-light-bulbs (3 items, generic 'Sale' name), /categories/sale-animal-prints-hides (2 items, generic 'Sale' name, current product prices show no visible markdown), /categories/young-house-love-lighting-sale (2 items, generic 'Sale' name, tied to a specific designer collaboration, prices DO show a markdown e.g. $118.15 vs $139.00). Each carries its own flag per the brief's ambiguous-sale rule rather than a guess either way. Products legitimately overlapping their normal category elsewhere is expected and not treated as an error.
